title: Custom ADR Management Software: Logistics Shielding and Dangerous Goods Compliance
body:
Do you know how much a single error in an ADR transport declaration costs your chemical plant?

Every day, hundreds of dangerous goods shipments are halted on the road due to discrepancies in UN numbers, incorrect calculations of exemption points, or cargo incompatibilities within the same trailer. This results not only in massive logistical delays and financial losses from customer penalties, but also in administrative fines that can completely paralyze your industrial activity.

The Trap of Excel Templates and Standard ERP Modules

Many companies trust the safety of their shipments to manual spreadsheets or generic patches within their traditional ERP that fail to update current international transport regulations. When different classes of hazardous materials are mixed, generic algorithms fail to calculate the mandatory segregation requirements in the warehouse and during loading. Trusting your company’s civil and criminal liability to a rigid module is playing Russian roulette with every truck that crosses your gates.

Our Solution: Custom ADR Compatibility and Documentation Logical Engine

We develop a centralized software architecture that completely automates the technical validation of your industrial shipments using data-crossing algorithms in milliseconds.

  1. Segregation matrix validation: The system automatically blocks the assignment of incompatible chemical products within the same physical container.
  2. Automated exemption point calculation: Evaluates the summation of the 1.1.3.6 rule in real-time to determine if the vehicle requires orange plates.
  3. Immutable dangerous goods note generation: Issuance of official ADR documents in PDF format ready for the carrier, integrated via API with your picking system.
  4. Updated UN substances database: A secure relational technical catalog that natively links codes, packing groups, and tunnel restrictions.

The Real Impact on Your Logistics Operations

  • Reduction of administrative fines to zero: Total elimination of human errors in mandatory declarations before transport authorities.
  • 85% savings in dispatch time: The warehouse team generates valid documentation instantly without needing to consult physical manuals.
  • Optimization of safe load capacity: Cubing algorithms that maximize space while strictly respecting legal mass and compatibility limitations.
